text: Assumption: Concurrent accesses to the same target key (targetCryIfKeyId) should also be synchronized — is this correct?

norm: concurrent accesses to the same target key targetcryifkeyid should also be synchronized
assumption: Concurrent accesses to the same target key (targetCryIfKeyId) should also be synchronized.
rationale: The specification literally mentions only cryIfKeyId as a reentrancy restriction, but concurrent writes to the same target resource typically involve conflicts.
